name: Breadcrumb
summary: A trail of ancestor links ending in the current page, with the DS caret separator.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-breadcrumb> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; feed it an `items` JSON array — each entry { label, href?, icon?, disabled? }: an entry with an `href` is a link, the last (or any href-less) entry is the current page (stronger colour, aria-current). A leading `icon` draws by name via <aha-icon>. `separator` picks the DS caret (default) or a slash; `maxItems` collapses the middle into an ellipsis toggle. Links + the ellipsis animate on hover via the shared motion tokens. Emits a composed `navigate` event.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `navigate`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Separator
spec.value: caret (<aha-icon name="system-caret-right" size=12>, icon-muted) or slash "/"

spec.label: Collapse
spec.value: maxItems > trail → first + ellipsis toggle + trailing (maxItems−1)

props.name: items
props.desc: The trail; an entry with href is a link, the last / href-less entry is the current page, icon adds a leading DS glyph, disabled mutes it

props.name: separator
props.desc: Divider glyph between crumbs — the DS caret (default) or a slash

props.name: maxItems
props.desc: Collapse the middle into an ellipsis toggle when the trail is longer than N (0 = never)

props.name: navigate
props.desc: Composed event on a link click, detail { index, href }

whenToUse.when: showing where a page sits in a hierarchy the user can climb back up
switching between sibling views at the same level — not a hierarchy
a single linear step back is all that's needed

opinion.note: Keep breadcrumbs to the real ancestor path — don't pad them. The last item is the current page and is never a link. Labels are short nouns, sentence case.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 Breadcrumb component set (fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy) with Components/Link + Components/Separator sub-parts. No measured px/rgb cell, so colour is token-derived: text-secondary link, text-default SemiBold current (stronger than the link, aria-current), color-primary hover, icon-muted separator, text-disabled disabled item. Matrix covered: leading item icons, caret vs slash separator, maxItems middle-collapse (ellipsis toggle), disabled item. Motion + glyphs bound to the shared motion tokens and the DS icon library.

snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-breadcrumb[data-probe]');var sr=el&&el.shadowRoot;var link=sr&&sr.querySelector('.crumb');var cur=sr&&sr.querySelector('.current');var nav=sr&&sr.querySelector('.nav');var icon=sr&&sr.querySelector('.crumb aha-icon');var sep=sr&&sr.querySelector('.sep');return{link:link?getComputedStyle(link).color:null,current:cur?getComputedStyle(cur).color:null,currentWeight:cur?getComputedStyle(cur).fontWeight:null,size:link?getComputedStyle(link).fontSize:null,gap:nav?getComputedStyle(nav).columnGap:null,hasIcon:!!icon,hasSeparator:!!sep};})()
